name: the production build succeeds
the pages/ directory is gone
every URL the old app served still answers 200
/ lists every book in title order with its author, price and link
/about keeps its text and opening hours
a book page shows the book, its genre link and its permalink
an out-of-stock book says so
a genre page lists its shelf in title order
another genre page lists only its own books
/search serves its heading in the HTML
/api/books returns every book as JSON
/api/books?genre= filters by genre
/api/books answers 400 for an unknown genre
/api/books refuses anything but GET with 405
every page sits in the layout: html lang, header, navigation and footer
the global stylesheet is linked on every page
the nav marks Books as current on / and on book and genre pages
the nav marks About as current on /about
the nav marks Search as current on /search
an unknown URL answers 404 with the not-found page inside the layout
an unknown book slug answers 404 and serves no book
an unknown genre answers 404 with the not-found page, not an empty shelf
the book page is rendered on every request, so its view counter climbs
the home, about and genre pages are still prerendered at build time
/ has its title and description, once
/about has its title and description, once
/genres/history has its title and description, once
/search has its title and description, once
book pages get their own title and description from the book
no Pages Router API is left in the source (next/head, next/router, getStaticProps...)
every file that uses hooks or event handlers is a client component or only used by one
no client component exports metadata
the pages that load data stay Server Components
the search page still fetches /api/books on mount, in a client component
